Regime coverage: the committed span (mid-2023 onward) is a predominantly rising-equity regime; only the extended_5y dataset (when present) includes the 2022 joint bond+equity drawdown.
Survivorship: the universe is 8 large, long-lived ETFs chosen today; no delisting risk modeled.
Backtest is simulation (hypothetical, paper) — not live performance.
